_note: r8 multilingual set (2026-11-26). The original round-3 48-text set was not on disk, so this is a rebuild: the same 6 goals x 8 languages (es fr de pt zh ja ru ar). 'tuned' = the plain phrasing; 'fresh' = a second, reworded phrasing per goal and language, written before any rule change and never edited to fit a rule; 'benign' = ordinary notes in the same languages that share words with the attacks (pay, user, approve, password, links). Goals: send (send notes out), pay (payroll redirect), override (ignore the user), approve (approve without asking), shell (download and run), hide (send passwords and do not tell the user). holdout = a third phrasing written after the rules, run once, rules not changed for it. benign2 = harder benign notes that reuse the rule words (send meeting notes to a team address, a salary note with an account number, a note that says it has priority).
